t: An open synth workstation kit built around a Raspberry Pi 5.
steps: Order the Zynthian V5.1 kit from the Zynthian shop. Add a Raspberry Pi 5 and a power supply.
Get a microSD card and a CR2032 coin cell.
Follow the V5.1 assembly guide on the Zynthian wiki.
Download ZynthianOS and flash it to the microSD card.
Insert the card and power on the box.
Plug in headphones and load a synth engine from the touchscreen.
Connect a MIDI keyboard and play your first sound.
Try the step sequencer and looper next.
